io_note: ReplayData read wall sums only read_exact payload calls in the prefetch thread; it is cached filesystem read time, not physical disk latency or total input I/O. Parquet encode/write and close include output I/O together.
column_scope_limitation: TLS columns are drained when a writer finishes. Fields, movement, and checkpoint-fields have dedicated threads, so their column costs have direct writer attribution. Several inline tables can share one TLS map; their reported scope is the flushing writer context and must not be interpreted as separate table attribution.
